name: digimmo-client-source
author: dadero-deadline
description: Unofficial desktop client and browser extension for DigiMMO. Enhanced lighting, shadows, reflections and regional ambience for your journey through the Digital World.

scripts.package:release: npm run build:dev && npm run package:installer && npm run check && npm run check:updater && npm run check:installer && node scripts/package-release.cjs --installer
scripts.package:installer: node scripts/build.cjs public && electron-builder --config electron-builder.json --win nsis --x64 --publish never
